aboutMe.name: Ming-Hsuan
aboutMe.title: Earth Scinece | Data Scientist | Natural Hazards | Content Creator
aboutMe.description: Science is not just knowing. It's discovering.

story.heading: Curiosity is everything 💡
paragraphs: I'm a scientist working in earth science, and a content creator exploring the world.
For the past few years I have studied earthquakes and natural hazards, using data to understand phenomena that resist prediction.
Somewhere in the research, I came to see this:
**What matters more than knowing an answer is noticing a question, and starting to look for one.**
So now I want to bring the way a researcher sees the world to more people.
Faced with a hard problem, how do we begin?
What makes an answer worth believing? What is the evidence? And when the evidence runs short, what can we still know?
From earthquakes and natural hazards to the things we take for granted in everyday life,
**all of it is worth asking again: why?**

story.heading: Travel, books, films, and overthinking 💭
paragraphs: Outside the research, I like to travel, read, watch films, and think about whatever life puts in front of me.
Living in Germany now, I keep meeting new questions — in different places, different books, different stories.
Since 2025 I have been turning those observations into videos and episodes on YouTube, sharing the world as I see it.
Sometimes it is science, sometimes a trip, sometimes a book or a film — sometimes just a question that turns up out of nowhere.
I don't know what I will find next.

experience.title: Research Data Scientist
descriptions: **Earthquake & Seismic Hazard Modeling:** Developed physics-based and statistical models of earthquake source behavior, ground motion, and seismic wave propagation using seismic data.
**Data & Computational Methods:** Built reproducible Python pipelines to integrate large, heterogeneous seismic and geospatial datasets across Europe for seismic hazard assessment.

**Research & Science Communication:** Published 5 journal articles in seismology, and communicated complex hazard modeling results to researchers, engineers, and non-specialists through reports, presentations, and conferences.

experience.title: Research Data Analyst
descriptions: **International Research Collaboration:** Contributed to international seismic hazard and risk meetings and facilitated cross-country collaboration, model development, and data exchange among research teams in Taiwan, Japan, and New Zealand.

**Earthquake Simulation & Hazard Modeling:** Conducted numerical simulations of historical earthquakes using SEM and FK + EXSIM to support earthquake hazard and risk modeling and high-stakes site evaluations.

**Cross-disciplinary Risk Assessment:** Collaborated with geologists, seismologists, and engineering seismologists to integrate geological, seismic, and engineering data into site risk assessments, delivering technical reports to government agencies.
